summary: Iteration 81: Drip Campaigns Feature - All 27 backend tests passed (100%), all 15 frontend UI tests passed (100%). Complete drip campaign system for re-engaging users stuck at funnel stages.

TEST_08_campaign_structure.notes: Has campaign_id, name, description, enabled, drip_days, total_sent

TEST_16_run_drip_success.notes: Returns sent, skipped, errors, message, run_at

TEST_17_run_drip_returns_details.notes: Details array with email, campaign, drip_day, status

TEST_19_history_success.notes: Returns logs array with total count

TEST_20_history_log_structure.notes: Has email, campaign_id, campaign_name, drip_day, sent_at

TEST_23_runs_structure.notes: Has triggered_by, run_at, sent, skipped, errors

TEST_F10_success_message.notes: Shows 'Drip check complete: X sent, Y skipped, Z errors'

TEST_F12_history_table.notes: Shows recipient, campaign, subject, drip day, sent at

backend_endpoints: GET /api/drip/campaigns - Lists 4 campaigns with enabled status and total_sent
POST /api/drip/run - Manually triggers drip check, sends emails to stuck users
GET /api/drip/history - Returns sent email logs with email, campaign, drip_day, sent_at
GET /api/drip/runs - Returns run history with triggered_by, sent, skipped, errors
All endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
frontend_components: 4 campaign cards with toggle switches (not_verified, not_onboarded, no_upload, inactive)
Run Now button triggers drip and shows result details
Show History button reveals email send log table
Auto-run info banner with last run timestamp
Campaign cards show drip schedule (Day 1, 3, 7) and total sent count
Sidebar has 'Drip Campaigns' link in ADMIN section
drip_campaigns: not_verified - Nudge users who signed up but haven't verified email
not_onboarded - Nudge users who verified email but haven't completed onboarding
no_upload - Nudge users who completed onboarding but haven't uploaded data
inactive - Re-engage users who uploaded data but haven't logged in recently
verified_features.drip_dedup: Running twice doesn't send duplicate emails (same user+campaign+day within 30 days)

seed_data_creation: None - 4 default campaigns auto-seeded on first access
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 81 verified complete Drip Campaigns implementation. Backend has 4 default campaigns (not_verified, not_onboarded, no_upload, inactive) auto-seeded on first access. Each campaign has Day 1, 3, 7 drip sequence. Emails sent via existing SMTP service (Hostinger). Drip logs stored in drip_logs collection, run history in drip_runs. Dedup check uses email+campaign_id+drip_day as key - won't re-send within 30 days. Daily auto-scheduler runs as asyncio background task. 8 emails already sent (visible in history). Frontend DripCampaigns.jsx shows 4 campaign cards with toggles, Run Now button, Show History button, and auto-run info banner.
